Method of Attack: JavaScript-based card-skimmer malware embedded within WooCommerce WordPress e-commerce site core files
Steals credit card numbers and CVV in plain text via cookies
Stores stolen payment card information within image files in wp-content/uploads directory
Employs multiple layers of encoding and concatenation to evade detection
Cleans its own tracks by zeroing out files before analysis
Attack Vector: Possibly compromised wp-admin account, SFTP password, hosting password, or vulnerable software in environment
Malicious code added to core JavaScript files of WooCommerce sites
